29975-one-martian-afternoon.title: One Martian Afternoon
29975-one-martian-afternoon.creator: Unknown
29975-one-martian-afternoon.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Before she realized it, a tiny, lime-washed stone house appeared not a hundred yards ahead of her. That was the odd thing about the Martian midday; something small and miles away would suddenly become large and very near as you approached it.

65715-narrative-of-a-five-years-expediti.creator: Unknown
65715-narrative-of-a-five-years-expediti.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. s; the whole so variegated as to afford, I hope, both information and amusement, without racking or depressing the spirits, and damping the mind; not indeed in the modern pomp and brilliancy of style, but in a simple tale, where TRUTH is the chief ornament.

75999-a-journey-of-joy.title: A Journey Of Joy
75999-a-journey-of-joy.creator: Unknown
75999-a-journey-of-joy.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It was the close of a gusty day in late November when two persons sat watching the early dusk close down upon the outside world. A long line of light still lingered behind the purple hills upon which there stood out a few houses silhouetted against the primrose yellow of the sky. Within the nearer confines of the lawn the leafless trees looked dim and shadowy.

arxiv-2012-00312.title: Density operator approach to turbulent flows in plasma and atmospheric fluids Preprint: 17th Russian Gravitational Conference - International Conference on Gravitation, Cosmology and Astrophysics (RUSGRAV-17) Preprint: Universe 6 , 216 (2020) [ DOI: 10.3390/universe6110216 ]
arxiv-2012-00312.creator: Konstantin G. Zloshchastiev
arxiv-2012-00312.description: Abstract We formulate a statistical wave-mechanical approach to describe dissipation and instabilities in two-dimensional turbulent flows of magnetized plasmas and atmospheric fluids, such as drift and Rossby waves. This is made possible by the existence of Hilbert space, associated with the electric potential of plasma or stream function of atmospheric fluid.

arxiv-2101-01480.title: Local Propagation for Few-Shot Learning
arxiv-2101-01480.creator: Yann Lifchitz, Yannis Avrithis, Sylvaine Picard
arxiv-2101-01480.description: Abstract The challenge in few-shot learning is that available data is not enough to capture the underlying distribution. To mitigate this, two emerging directions are (a) using local image representations, essentially multiplying the amount of data by a constant factor, and (b) using more unlabeled data, for instance by transductive inference, jointly on a number of queries.

arxiv-2204-09640.title: Probabilistic AutoRegressive Neural Networks for Accurate Long-range Forecasting
arxiv-2204-09640.creator: Madhurima Panja, Tanujit Chakraborty, Uttam Kumar, Abdenour Hadid
arxiv-2204-09640.description: Abstract Forecasting time series data is a critical area of research with applications spanning from stock prices to early epidemic prediction. While numerous statistical and machine learning methods have been proposed, real-life prediction problems often require hybrid solutions that bridge classical forecasting approaches and modern neural network models.

arxiv-2209-13619.title: LapGM: A Multisequence MR Bias Correction and Normalization Model
arxiv-2209-13619.creator: Luciano Vinas*, Arash A. Amini, Jade Fischer, Atchar Sudhyadhom
arxiv-2209-13619.description: Abstract A spatially regularized Gaussian mixture model, LapGM, is proposed for the bias field correction and magnetic resonance normalization problem. The proposed spatial regularizer gives practitioners fine-tuned control between balancing bias field removal and preserving image contrast preservation for multi-sequence, magnetic resonance images.

arxiv-2301-01460.title: Computational Models for High-Power Cyclotrons and FFAs
arxiv-2301-01460.creator: Chris T. Rogers
arxiv-2301-01460.description: Abstract A summary of numerical modeling capabilities regarding high power cyclotrons and fixed field alternating gradient machines is presented. This paper focuses on techniques made available by the OPAL simulation code. 1 Overview on Computational Models In all high-power particle accelerators "one of the major limitations is particle losses.

arxiv-2311-16492.title: VLPrompt: Vision-Language Prompting for Panoptic Scene Graph Generation
arxiv-2311-16492.creator: Zijian Zhou, Miaojing Shi, Holger Caesar
arxiv-2311-16492.description: Abstract Panoptic Scene Graph Generation (PSG) aims at achieving a comprehensive image understanding by simultaneously segmenting objects and predicting relations among objects. However, the long-tail problem among relations leads to unsatisfactory results in real-world applications. Prior methods predominantly rely on vision information or utilize limited language information, such as object or relation names, thereby overlooking the utility of language information.

arxiv-2312-01950.title: Convergence Of The Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm For Discontinuous Gradients
arxiv-2312-01950.creator: Tim Johnston, Sotirios Sabanis
arxiv-2312-01950.description: Abstract We demonstrate that for strongly log-convex densities whose potentials are discontinuous on manifolds, the ULA algorithm converges with stepsize bias of order 1 / 2 1/2 in Wasserstein-p distance. Our resulting bound is then of the same order as the convergence of ULA for gradient Lipschitz potential.

arxiv-2401-03281.title: Statistical Response of ENSO Complexity to Initial Condition and Model Parameter Perturbations
arxiv-2401-03281.description: Abstract Studying the response of a climate system to perturbations has practical significance. Standard methods in computing the trajectory-wise deviation caused by perturbations may suffer from the chaotic nature that makes the model error dominate the true response after a short lead time.

arxiv-2408-17317.title: Diagnosing crosstalk in large-scale QPUs using zero-entropy classical shadows
arxiv-2408-17317.creator: J. A. Montañez-Barrera, G. P. Beretta, Kristel Michielsen, Michael R. von Spakovsky
arxiv-2408-17317.description: Abstract As quantum processing units (QPUs) scale toward hundreds of qubits, diagnosing crosstalk and noise-induced correlations becomes critical for reliable quantum computation. In this work, we introduce Zero-Entropy Classical Shadows (ZECS), a diagnostic tool that reconstructs positive semidefinite, unit-trace density operators from classical shadow (CS) information. ZECS enables proper subregion tomography and reduces the effect of sampling and time-dependent errors.

arxiv-2411-15375.title: AdamZ: An Enhanced Optimisation Method for Neural Network Training
arxiv-2411-15375.creator: Ilia Zaznov, Atta Badii, Julian Kunkel, Alfonso Dufour
arxiv-2411-15375.description: Abstract AdamZ is an advanced variant of the Adam optimiser, developed to enhance convergence efficiency in neural network training. This optimiser dynamically adjusts the learning rate by incorporating mechanisms to address overshooting and stagnation, that are common challenges in optimisation.

arxiv-2505-20056.title: PAMD: Plausibility-Aware Motion Diffusion Model for Long Dance Generation
arxiv-2505-20056.creator: Hongsong Wang, Yin Zhu, Qiuxia Lai, Yang Zhang, Guo-Sen Xie, Xin Geng
arxiv-2505-20056.description: Abstract Computational dance generation is crucial in many areas, such as art, human-computer interaction, virtual reality, and digital entertainment, particularly for generating coherent and expressive long dance sequences. Diffusion-based music-to-dance generation has made significant progress, yet existing methods still struggle to produce physically plausible motions.

arxiv-2602-16343.title: How to Label Resynthesized Audio: The Dual Role of Neural Audio Codecs in Audio Deepfake Detection
arxiv-2602-16343.creator: Yixuan Xiao, Florian Lux, Alejandro Pérez-González-de-Martos, Ngoc Thang Vu
arxiv-2602-16343.description: Abstract Since Text-to-Speech systems typically don’t produce waveforms directly, recent spoof detection studies use resynthesized waveforms from vocoders and neural audio codecs to simulate an attacker. Unlike vocoders, which are specifically designed for speech synthesis, neural audio codecs were originally developed for compressing audio for storage and transmission.

arxiv-2605-09717.creator: Gilles Germain

pmc-11311658.title: A Cross-Sectional Survey of Healthcare Professionals’ Knowledge, Attitude and Current Behaviours towards Female Fertility Preservation Services within the UK
pmc-11311658.creator: Lorraine S. Kasaven, Anita Mitra, Mehar Chawla, Sughashini Murugesu, Nicholas Anson, Jara Ben Nagi, Efstathios Theodorou, Michael P. Rimmer, Bassel Al-Wattar, Joseph Yazbek, Benjamin P. Jones, Srdjan Saso
pmc-11311658.description: Simple SummaryHealthcare professionals recognise the importance of fertility preservation and their responsibility to initiate discussions. However, despite advanced training within respective fields, discrepancies in knowledge remain regarding techniques of fertility preservation, referral pathways and existing educational resources available to patients, preventing efficient implementation of services.

pmc-11367541.title: Analyzing nonlinear and asymmetric effects of green finance and renewable energy on energy efficiency amidst technological innovation in E7 countries
pmc-11367541.creator: Mingda Shi, Jing Yu
pmc-11367541.description: The study aims to explore the relationship between green funding, green energy, and energy efficiency in E7 countries, guided by the SDG-7 guidelines recommended by the United Nations General Assembly. Methodologically, the study employs the Nonlinear Autoregressive Distributed Lag (NARDL) and Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) techniques on data collected between 1988 and 2022.

pmc-11632922.title: The complete mitochondrial genome of Proedromys bedfordi Thomas 1911 (Arvicolinae, Rodentia)
pmc-11632922.creator: Shiqing Wang, Chen Lin, Zhen Wang, Zhangwen Deng
pmc-11632922.description: The Duke of Bedford’s vole (Proedromys bedfordi Thomas 1911) is distributed only at the border areas of the Sichuan and Gansu Provinces, China. In this study, the first complete mitochondrial genome of P. bedfordi is generated and characterized. The assembled genome is 16,262 base pairs in length and the base compositions present clearly the A-T bias (60.84%).

pmc-11635206.title: Effect of exercise on physical fitness and quality of life in patients with pulmonary embolism: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11635206.creator: Meng Chen, Yuchuan Wang, Tiantian Zhou, Jingjing He, Min Zhang, Zhenlong Yan, Junjie Tao, Ping Huang
pmc-11635206.description: BackgroundPulmonary embolism (PE) survivors frequently experience persistent dyspnea and diminished quality of life (QoL). Evidence suggests that rehabilitation exercise has a positive impact on QoL, physical fitness, and dyspnea in patients with heart disease and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. However, the effects of exercise on patients with PE remain ambiguous.

pmc-12597617.title: Identification LEF1 as a Potential Novel Biomarker for Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms Based on Comprehensive Bioinformatics Analysis
pmc-12597617.creator: Pan He, Xinyi Liu, Hanshen Luo, Yuehang Yang, Jiong Guo
pmc-12597617.description: Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA), a life‐threatening cardiovascular disorder, necessitates the identification of novel molecular biomarkers to facilitate early diagnosis and precision therapeutic interventions. In this study, we employed an integrative bioinformatics strategy to systematically identify and characterise a potential biomarker for AAA.

pmc-12655625.title: Canine Leishmaniasis in Europe over the Last Decade: A Review of Geographic Trends and Epidemiological Data
pmc-12655625.creator: Anamaria Plesko, Tiana Florea, Mirela Imre, Diana Hoffman, Ioan Cristian Dreghiciu, Alexandra Pocinoc, Florica Morariu, Ana-Maria Marin, Narcisa Mederle, Gheorghe Darabus, Ion Oprescu, Marius Stelian Ilie, Sorin Morariu, Patrícia De Almeida Machado, Ari Sérgio De Oliveira Lemos, Juliana Da Trindade
pmc-12655625.description: Canine leishmaniasis is an emerging threat in Europe shaped by ecological, climatic, and socio-economic factors. This systematic review examines the prevalence of Leishmania spp. infection in dogs, based on information collected from studies published between 2015 and 2024 across 14 European countries. Available data was compiled and analyzed following PRISMA guidelines, revealing pronounced geographical variability.

pmc-13215585.title: A new visual index for assessing zooplankton biomass and its utility in assessing prey availability for megaplanktivores
pmc-13215585.creator: Hannah M Moloney, Asia O Armstrong, Guy M W Stevens, Christine L Dudgeon, Joanna L Harris, Kathy A Townsend, Anthony J Richardson, Marja Koski
pmc-13215585.description: Zooplankton are vital links in marine food webs, yet their biomass remains challenging to quantify across broad spatial and temporal scales. This study introduces the Zooplankton Visual Index–a simple, rapid and scalable semi-quantitative method for evaluating zooplankton biomass through underwater observations.

pmc-13286642.title: Assessing Social Vulnerability and FDA Tobacco Retailer Compliance Inspections and Violations in Los Angeles County, CA (2021–2023)
pmc-13286642.creator: Ana L Herrera, Denise D Payán
pmc-13286642.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionTobacco control policies aim to limit access, reduce initiation, and mitigate tobacco-related harms, particularly among youth. However, the effectiveness of these policies relies on consistent enforcement to ensure widespread compliance and achieve their intended public health impacts. Socioeconomic vulnerability and neighborhood characteristics have been shown to influence retailer compliance, although existing studies often primarily focus on compliance violations instead of inspections.

pmc-13350747.title: Number comparison in bilinguals is not affected by their second language
pmc-13350747.creator: Silke M. Göbel, Veniamin Shiron, Miriam Tucker, Angela De Bruin
pmc-13350747.description: Language background can show subtle effects on number comparison even with Arabic digits. Number pairs can be decade-unit compatible, i.e. the decision about number size is the same for unit and decade (e.g. 24 and 57, 2 < 5 and 4 < 7), or decade-unit incompatible (e.g. 29 and 57, 2 < 5 but 9 > 7).

pmc-13448066.title: Unintended tripping of healthy parallel lines during single-line-to-ground faults: field evidence and mitigation
pmc-13448066.creator: Farhad Aghajanian Sabagh, Farzad Hajimohammadi, Bahador Fani, Iman Sadeghkhani
pmc-13448066.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Distance relays may maloperate under various conditions such as improper settings, measurement distortion, or abnormal network operating states. This article investigates an overlooked mechanism leading to distance relay maloperation in parallel sub-transmission circuits containing underground cable sections. During a single-phase-to-ground fault on one circuit, a portion of the fault current may return through the neutrals of receiving-end transformers and flow back toward the source through the parallel healthy circuit.

pmc-13556853.title: 567. cGAS–STING Pathway Activation in Microglia in a Mouse Model of GLUT1 Deficiency Syndrome: Cognitive Improvement with STING Inhibition and a Ketogenic Diet
pmc-13556853.creator: N Aruga, S Tamura, H Shimbo, S Hirai
pmc-13556853.description: BackgroundGlucose transporter type 1 deficiency syndrome (GLUT1-DS) is an inherited metabolic encephalopathy primarily caused by reduced expression and/or function of the GLUT1 protein. A wide range of neurological symptoms, including epilepsy and cognitive impairment, have been reported in affected individuals. Currently, no established therapy is available for GLUT1-DS, and ketogenic diet therapy is applied as a symptomatic treatment.

pmc-13630571.title: Longitudinal analysis of drift in the circulating human antibody repertoire over four years
pmc-13630571.creator: Collin Joyce, Benjamin Nemoz, Raiza Bastidas, Bryan Briney, Dennis R Burton
pmc-13630571.description: The human immune system is a sophisticated network of cells and molecules that plays a vital role in safeguarding the body against a broad range of foreign agents. One of the key components of the immune system is the circulating antibody repertoire, a vast collection of different antibodies that recognize and eliminate foreign agents specifically.
